lines.en: Would you like to respond?
lines.zh: 要回复吗？

lines.en: What would you like to say?
lines.zh: 你想说点什么？

lines.en: : {i}Cool glasses, Molly. They really bring that overly complicated outfit together.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}眼镜很酷啊，Molly。有了它，你那套过于复杂的服装总算完整了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}When he compliments the one part of your costume you didn't make yourself T_T{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}他夸的偏偏是你这套服装里唯一不是自己做的那部分 T_T{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I have a hard time believing you made that belt. Leatherworking is a difficult skill to master and you're just a teenage girl.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我很难相信那条腰带是你自己做的。皮革工艺是门很难精通的手艺，而你只是个十几岁的女孩。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}A teenage girl who has maxed four different leatherworkers on four different servers and you will give me the respect I deserve{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}一个在四个不同服务器上把四个皮革匠都练满级的十几岁女孩，而且你会给我应得的尊重{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Just kidding, sir. Thank you. I appreciate you not immediately deleting this picture from your phone{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}开玩笑的，先生。谢谢您。很感激您没有立刻把这张照片从手机里删掉{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Why would I do that?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我为什么要那么做？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Because you didn't ask for it and you probably think it's weird to be getting something from me out of literally nowhere{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}因为您又没要过，而且您大概觉得，平白无故收到我发来的东西挺奇怪的{/i}

lines.en: : {i}If anything, I'd say you don't send me picture messages enough.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}要说的话，我反倒觉得你给我发的图片消息还不够多。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Since when do you have any interest in pictures of me???? I have millions of cosplay photos that are just consuming space on my phone at this point{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}您从什么时候开始对我的照片感兴趣了？？？？我手机里存着成千上万张角色扮演的照片，到这会儿都只是在占内存而已{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Are you saying I should have been sending those to you all along????{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}您是说，我早就该把这些发给您了？？？？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yes. That is exactly what I'm saying.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}对。我就是这个意思。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And just to clarify, you are talking about pictures of me and not all of the pictures I've taken of the OTHER girls cosplaying???{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}还有，先确认一下，您说的是我的照片，而不是我给其他 cos 的女孩拍的那堆照片？？？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I mean, I'd accept all of them. But yeah, I'm talking about you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我是说，我全都收。不过对，我说的是你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Sir, are you just nicer through text? Because I can relate to that and if it's not a problem we can just talk like this from now on{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}先生，您只是在打字的时候比较温柔吗？因为我完全能理解，如果方便的话，我们以后就这么聊也行{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm honestly more comfortable like this anyway. It's easier to be confident when you can just backspace all of your negative thoughts!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}说实话我也更习惯这样。只要能把所有负面想法一键退格删除，人就容易自信多了！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'd prefer to still talk in person if that's cool. Phones are good for receiving nudes and that's pretty much it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如果可以的话，我还是更想当面聊。手机嘛，就适合用来收裸照，基本就这点用处。{/i}
{i}O_O{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I don't know if I'm ready to send those just yet sir{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我还不确定自己准备好发那种照片了，先生{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm not asking you to. Just clarifying my stance in regard to cell phones.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我没要求你发。只是想澄清我对手机的立场。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Then I am inclined to disagree, sir. I have many fond memories of playing games on my phone and.......absolutely none of having ever received nudes from anyone.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那我恐怕不能苟同，先生。我有很多在手机上玩游戏的美好回忆，至于收到别人的裸照……一次都没有过。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Unless you count the ones the Magistrate has sent to me on accident.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}除非您把司政官不小心发给我的那些也算上。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm not sure if those were actually accidents, Molly.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我可不确定那些真的是不小心的，Molly。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Oh yay. That makes me feel a lot better about what I proceeded to do with them.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦太好了。这下我对自己拿它们做了什么，感觉舒坦多了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I mean what{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我是说，什么{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What happened to backspacing your negative thoughts?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你那些负面想法不是都能退格删掉吗，怎么了？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Nothing happened sir. I'm a good girl who sees her boss as a boss.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么都没发生，先生。我是个好女孩，只把老板当成老板看。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm not sure if I believe that after seeing what you've done with pictures of your coworkers.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}看了你拿同事的照片干了什么之后，我可不确定这话能信。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}PLEASE FORGET THAT ALREADY. THE DOOR SHOULD HAVE BEEN LOCKED.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}求您快把那件事忘了吧。那扇门本来就该锁上的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}No door is ever locked for me. It's just the way the world works.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}对我来说，没有哪扇门是锁着的。世界就是这么运转的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}DAMN H-GAME PROTAGONISTS AND THEIR SEX-VISION.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}该死的 H 游戏主角和他们的透视眼。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Though I'd be lying if I said I was not envious of your powers, sir. I don't blame you at all for collecting as many CGs as you can.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过要说我一点都不羡慕您的能力，那是骗人的，先生。您尽力多收集 CG，这一点我完全不怪您。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Thanks. I think.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}谢谢。大概吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Don't mention it! Now please excuse me as I finish editing Kafka's pictures.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不用谢！那么请恕我失陪，我得把 Kafka 的照片修完。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Who?{/i}
: {i}You will see soon, sir!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}您很快就会看到的，先生！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What am I looking at exactly?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我具体是在看什么？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Ginger wolf!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}姜黄色的狼！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Or, more accurately Silver Wolf. A character from Honkai Star Rail, miHoYo's latest game. Not to be confused with Honkai Impact, which is the game we took our costumes from last year.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}或者更准确地说，是银狼。《崩坏：星穹铁道》里的角色，米哈游最新的游戏。别和《崩坏 3》搞混了，我们去年的服装就出自那款游戏。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Neat.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不错嘛。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You aren't actually interested at all, are you sir?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}您其实一点兴趣都没有，对吧，先生？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}No, but I'm glad you found something you can be passionate about. All I have is porn.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}没有，不过我很高兴你能找到愿意投入热情的东西。我有的只有色情片。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well then you're in luck sir because the miHoYo games have a TON of that. Which means that you should have at least some interest in our costumes by proxy{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那您可走运了，先生，因为米哈游的游戏里那种东西多的是。也就是说，您至少该对我们的服装有点间接兴趣吧{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Are you telling me that I can go online and look up porn for the character you're dressed as right now?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你是说，我可以上网搜你现在扮的这个角色的色情图？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Rule 34 sir. If it exists, there is porn of it. And rule 34 section 9c is that, if it's a miHoYo property, there's even more of it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}互联网第 34 条法则，先生。只要它存在，就一定有色情内容。而第 34 条法则第 9c 款补充：如果是米哈游的 IP，那就更多了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You'd be better off with one of the other costumes I've done, though. Star Rail is still relatively new, so the porn catalogue isn't exactly as populated as it will be a year from now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过您不如搜我以前扮过的其他角色。星穹铁道还算新，色情图库暂时没到一年后那么丰富。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And what was the character's name again?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那个角色叫什么来着？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Just scroll up sir.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}往上翻就行，先生。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Just tell me again. My dominant hand is too occupied to scroll right now and typing is hard enough.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你再说一遍吧。我的惯用手现在忙得没法翻，光打字就已经够费劲了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Have you...already gotten started? Before even looking anything up?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}您……已经开始了？连搜都还没搜？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I have a problem, Molly.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我是有病，Molly。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}As do I, sir. But I'm inclined to call this determination rather than anything detrimental to your health. I applaud your ingenuity and my mind is definitely not wandering right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我也是，先生。不过我更愿意把这叫作决断力，而不是什么有害健康的东西。我钦佩您的机智，而且我脑子里现在绝对没有在乱想。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The character's name. What was it and what do I type in?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那个角色的名字。叫什么，我该输入什么？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Silver Wolf, sir. Search on Pixiv. It's the ultimate repository.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}银狼，先生。去 Pixiv 上搜。那是终极宝库。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Are you actually doing this right now?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}您现在真的在做吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Wow, you weren't kidding. There's a lot on here.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哇，你没开玩笑。上面真多啊。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You wouldn't...have any interest in perhaps facetiming me right now, would you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}您……有没有兴趣现在跟我打个视频电话呢？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Can't. Busy.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不行。忙着呢。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I understand that, but if I'm able to help in some way...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我明白，不过如果我能在某些方面帮上忙的话……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And I'm done.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我完事了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Done???{/i}
: {i}Yeah.{/i}
: {i}Already?!?!{/i}
: {i}I got a head start.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我抢跑了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}By how long?! You didn't respond until a few minutes ago!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}抢跑了多久？！您几分钟前才回我消息啊！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I got started the moment you sent this picture to me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你发来这张照片的那一刻，我就开始了。{/i}
{i}O_O{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You're kidding{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}您在开玩笑吧{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Right???{/i}
: {i}Did you actually???{/i}
: {i}Anyway, see you later. Thanks for the porn recommendation. Feel free to send more pictures whenever.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}总之，回头见。多谢推荐好东西。随时欢迎再发照片过来。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Molly, don't take this the wrong way, but you are so fucking hot.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Molly，别误会，不过你真的他妈的太辣了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Like, really. Just look at the way you're carrying yourself here. You're so confident and comfortable and you're really just extraordinarily attractive.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}真的。就看看你在这儿的仪态。你是那么自信、那么自在，而且真的非常有魅力。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Okay, Ami. You can give Sensei the phone back now{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}行了，Ami。你可以把手机还给老师了{/i}

lines.en: : {i}This isn't Ami.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这不是 Ami。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Ayane?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Ayane？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Nope.{/i}
: {i}Well, who else would go out of their way to boost my morale like this? Because it sure wouldn't be Rin{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那还有谁会特意跑来给我打气？反正肯定不会是 Rin{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Me. Your teacher. The owner of this phone.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我。你的老师。这部手机的主人。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And who put you up to this exactly? Because you have never been the type to openly express any amount of adoration for me at all sir{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那到底是谁指使您这么做的？因为您从来都不是那种会坦率表达一丁点爱慕之情的人啊，先生{/i}

lines.en: : {i}No one put me up to this. I just wanted you to know how attractive I think you are and that, despite my actions, I still fantasize about impregnating you{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}没人指使我。我只是想让你知道，我觉得你有多迷人；还有，尽管我做过那些事，我依然幻想着让你怀上我的孩子{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Okay now I know it's not Sensei. Very funny Ami. I'm sorry for sending your uncle a picture message. But IN MY DEFENSE I'd send yours too if you joined us this year{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好了，我现在确定不是老师。真有你的，Ami。抱歉我把图片消息发给了你舅舅。不过说句公道话，要是你今年也一起参加，我也会发给你的{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Again, this isn't Ami. This is your teacher. Just expressing his interest in wanting to impregnate a teenage girl via text message.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}再说一次，这不是 Ami。这是你的老师。只是通过短信表达一下，他有多想让一个十几岁的女孩怀上他的孩子。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}THIS ISN'T FUNNY ANYMORE{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这已经不好笑了{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Probably because it's not a joke, Molly. Let me say something nice about you for once.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}大概因为这本来就不是玩笑，Molly。就让我夸你一次吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}How am I supposed to respond right now if I don't know who I'm actually talking to?!?! Saying anything at all could incriminate me in some way!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我都不知道自己到底在跟谁说话，让我怎么回啊？！？！不管说什么，都有可能让我在某种程度上把自己给卖了！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Incriminate you for what exactly?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}卖了什么，具体说说？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}See! Now you're probing me for information! I'm sorry! I'll stop sending him pictures! I just thought he'd like the costume and the photo came out really well!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}看吧！您现在就是在套我的话！对不起！我不给他发照片了！我只是觉得他会喜欢这套服装，而且照片拍得确实不错！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It sure did. Please send more of them.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}确实拍得很好。请多发几张。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}FINE I'LL STAY AWAY FOREVER AND NEVER COSPLAY AGAIN{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}行吧 那我永远离您远远的 再也不出 cos 了{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Molly, it's fine. Really. I just want you to know you're beautiful because I know you struggle with your confidence at times.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Molly，没事的。真的。我只是想让你知道你很漂亮，因为我知道你有时会跟自己的自信较劲。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}GOODBYE AMI I AM TURNING OFF MY PHONE NOW{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}再见 AMI 我要关机了{/i}
